metrics.name: forge.metrics.rejected_attributes
metrics.description: Measurements whose attribute was not in the metric's declaration, corrected before export. A rising value means code records an attribute the schema does not list.

metrics.name: forge.server.drain.duration
metrics.description: How long each phase of a graceful shutdown took: the pre-stop pause, the listener drain (unary requests and long-lived streams), stopping workers and operators, the caller's teardown, each node a lifecyclekit supervisor stops (node), and the whole shutdown (total).

metrics.name: go.config.gogc
metrics.description: Heap size target percentage configured by the user, otherwise 100.

metrics.name: go.goroutine.count
metrics.description: Count of live goroutines.

metrics.name: go.memory.allocated
metrics.description: Memory allocated to the heap by the application.

metrics.name: go.memory.allocations
metrics.description: Count of allocations to the heap by the application.

metrics.name: go.memory.gc.goal
metrics.description: Heap size target for the end of the GC cycle.

metrics.name: go.memory.limit
metrics.description: Go runtime memory limit configured by the user, when one exists.

metrics.name: go.memory.used
metrics.description: Memory used by the Go runtime.

metrics.name: go.processor.limit
metrics.description: The number of OS threads that can execute user-level Go code simultaneously.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_closed_max_idle
metrics.description: Connections closed because of SetMaxIdleConns.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_closed_max_idle_time
metrics.description: Connections closed because of SetConnMaxIdleTime.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_closed_max_lifetime
metrics.description: Connections closed because of SetConnMaxLifetime.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_idle
metrics.description: Idle connections.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_in_use
metrics.description: Connections currently in use.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_max_open
metrics.description: Maximum number of open connections to the database.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_open
metrics.description: Established connections, in use and idle.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_wait_count
metrics.description: Total number of times a caller waited for a connection.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_wait_duration
metrics.description: Total time blocked waiting for a new connection.

metrics.name: go.sql.query_timing
metrics.description: Timing of processed database queries.

metrics.name: jobs_in_flight
metrics.description: Jobs running.

metrics.name: order_value
metrics.description: Order value at creation.

metrics.name: orders_created
metrics.description: Orders created.

metrics.name: queue_depth
metrics.description: Jobs waiting.

metrics.name: rpc.server.calls
metrics.description: Total RPC calls received.

metrics.name: rpc.server.duration
metrics.description: RPC duration.

metrics.name: rpc.server.errors
metrics.description: Total RPC calls that returned an error, by connect code and error class (server fault, user error, canceled).
